summary: A Claude transcript record st does not know (such as the request blob Claude now writes) is always shown as Claude's own bookkeeping, never as a line from the person, whatever message role it carries

replay.detail: Conversation entries are normalized when read; no claim replay or recovery behavior.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Frames and the client API are unchanged. Only the role given to an unrecognized Claude record changes, from the record's own role to system.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; schema and rules versions are unchanged.
